# Free calculators and checks for people who run a small business

> 1279 free, browser-only tools for marketplace sellers, trade contractors, logistics buyers, and small teams preparing compliance evidence. No account, no payment: every calculation runs in the visitor's own browser, and the numbers they type never leave their device — except on Does your pinned workflow load something unpinned underneath it?, ATS Resume Checker, CAA Record Checker, Cancel Flow, Changelog Keeper, Churn Radar, Cron Heartbeat, Deal Keeper, DNS Change Evidence, Drip Keeper, Dunning Engine, Email Authentication Checker (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), Error Keeper, Feedback Board, Form Inbox, ICP Lens, License Keeper, Would a spend cap have stopped your runaway LLM bill?, Meter Keeper, MRR Pulse, PQL Radar, Proposal Maker, Which of your PyPI dependencies lack a provenance attestation?, Which federal contracts in my niche expire next?, Rev Rec, Review Reply Desk, RFP Compliance Matrix Generator, Sales Call Notes Desk, Sign Keeper, Slot Keeper, Sponsor Ready, status-keeper, Subdomain Takeover Checker, Support Desk, Survey Keeper, Testimonial Keeper, Trial Converter, Did an extension you already trust just change what it does?, Waitlist Keeper, and webhook-relay, where the one thing you paste is sent to the public API it checks; the About page explains exactly what.

Each tool is a static page that works offline once opened, and is free with no
gated features. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional
advice or a determination made on anyone's behalf; each page carries its own
limitations.

## Self-hosted business apps

Open-source business software you run on your own server: failed-payment recovery, cancellation flows, MRR and revenue recognition, lifecycle email, referrals, feature flags, status pages, help centres, booking pages, cookie-free analytics and more. Deploy your own copy with your own keys; you own the data.

Category page: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/c/self-hosted/

- [Cancel Flow — save-offer cancellation flow for Stripe, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/cancel-flow/): Keep subscribers who only needed a nudge. A cancellation flow for Stripe that asks why, offers a pause or a discount matched to the reason, and reports your save rate. Preview it in the browser, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT.
- [Changelog Keeper — changelog page, feeds and a What's new widget, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/changelog-keeper/): Publish product updates on a public changelog page with Atom and JSON feeds and an embeddable What's new bell with an unread badge. Scheduled posts, drafts, Slack webhook. Open source, MIT, one-click self-deploy, no monthly fee.
- [Churn Radar — see who is about to cancel before they do](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/churn-radar/): A free, open-source alternative to ChurnZero and Gainsight for small SaaS: learn from your own usage events which accounts are about to cancel, with an honest out-of-time accuracy check. Paste an export and try it in your browser first.
- [Cron Heartbeat — dead man's switch for cron jobs, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/cron-heartbeat/): Know when a cron job silently stops. Paste your crontab to get next runs, the right grace period and a wrapped line that pings a heartbeat monitor you can self-host with zero dependencies. Free, open source, runs in your browser.
- [Deal Keeper — which deals are really at risk, and what will actually close](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/deal-keeper/): A free, open-source alternative to the forecasting add-ons of Pipedrive, HubSpot and Clari for small B2B teams: win chances learned from your own closed deals, a backtested forecast range and a ranked list of stale or slipping deals. Paste a deal export and try it in your browser.
- [Drip Keeper — self-hosted lifecycle email](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/drip-keeper/): A free, open-source alternative to Customer.io, Loops and Userlist: your app posts events, sequences send onboarding, trial and win-back email, and a goal event stops the rest. Preview exactly what a person would receive and when, in your browser, then run the server in your own account.
- [Dunning Engine — failed payment recovery for Stripe, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/dunning-engine/): Recover failed Stripe subscription payments with decline-code-aware retries and emails you control. Preview the recovery schedule for any decline code, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT, no per-recovery fee.
- [Error Keeper — know when your app breaks, on your own server](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/error-keeper/): A free, open-source alternative to Sentry and Rollbar for small teams: groups the same bug together, alerts on new errors, regressions and spikes, one Node process and one JSON file. Paste stack traces and see the grouping in your browser first.
- [Feedback Board — a Canny alternative you host yourself](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/feedback-board/): Collect feature requests, let customers vote, catch duplicates as they type, publish a roadmap and a changelog with RSS. One small open-source server you run yourself. Free, MIT, no per-user fee. Try the duplicate finder in your browser.
- [Flag Keeper — self-hosted feature flags](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/flag-keeper/): A free, open-source alternative to LaunchDarkly, Flagsmith and Unleash: percentage rollouts that stay sticky, targeting rules, segments, prerequisites and a kill switch in one small server. Simulate a rollout and see exactly who would flip before you ship it, in your browser.
- [Form Inbox — a Formspree alternative you host yourself](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/form-inbox/): Point any HTML form at your own server: spam scoring with visible reasons, an inbox, CSV export and email or Slack notifications. Open source, MIT, no per-submission fee. Test the spam filter in your browser.
- [Help Keeper — a help center that tells you what to write next](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/help-keeper/): A help center you host yourself: Markdown articles, typo-tolerant ranked search, helpful votes and a report of what visitors searched for and could not find. Open source, MIT, no per-seat fee. Try the search in your browser.
- [License Keeper — license keys for Stripe sellers, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/license-keeper/): Sell desktop apps, plugins and CLI tools with Stripe and issue signed license keys automatically. Generate a key pair, sign a test license and verify it right in your browser, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT, no per-license fee.
- [Link Keeper — self-hosted link shortener with click stats](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/link-keeper/): A free, open-source alternative to Bitly, Dub and Rebrandly: your own short domain, UTM-tagged campaign links, iOS/Android app routing, expiry, click limits and privacy-friendly stats with no cookies and no stored IPs. Plan a batch of links in your browser first.
- [Meter Keeper — self-hosted usage metering for Stripe](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/meter-keeper/): A free, open-source alternative to Lago, Orb and Metronome for small SaaS: send usage events to your own server, get exact per-customer usage, tiered invoice previews, hard-limit checks, and a reliable feed into Stripe Billing Meters. Try your pricing on real usage numbers in your browser first.
- [MRR Pulse — Stripe MRR and churn dashboard, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/mrr-pulse/): See MRR, ARR, net revenue retention, logo churn and quick ratio from your Stripe subscriptions without paying a metrics service a share of your revenue. Paste a subscription export to try it in the browser, then run the open-source read-only server in your own account. Free, MIT.
- [PQL Radar — find the free signups about to become customers](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/pql-radar/): A free, open-source alternative to MadKudu and Pocus for small SaaS: learn from your own signups which first-week behaviour comes before paying, with an honest out-of-time accuracy check. Paste an export and try it in your browser first.
- [Referral Keeper — a self-hosted affiliate program for Stripe sellers](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/referral-keeper/): Run an affiliate or referral program on your own Stripe account: tracking link, recurring commissions, refund clawbacks, payout CSV. Plan what a program will cost you in your browser, then deploy the open-source server. Free, MIT, no revenue share.
- [Rev Rec — Stripe deferred revenue schedule, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/rev-rec/): Turn Stripe invoices into a monthly revenue recognition schedule: billings, revenue recognised, deferred revenue and journal entries for your bookkeeper. Paste an invoice export to try it in the browser, then run the open-source read-only server in your own account. Free, MIT.
- [Self-Hosted SaaS Stack: Open-Source Alternatives to Calendly, Sentry, LaunchDarkly and Help Scout](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/self-hosted-saas-stack/): 28 open-source, self-hosted tools that replace the small-SaaS subscriptions a founder pays for: booking, help center, error tracking, feature flags, analytics, email, referrals, billing metrics and e-signature. MIT licensed, zero dependencies, one-click deploy.
- [Sign Keeper — self-hosted e-signature with a verifiable certificate](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/sign-keeper/): Send a signing link, collect a typed signature with consent, and keep a certificate anyone can re-verify. A free, open-source, self-hosted alternative to per-envelope e-signature pricing.
- [Slot Keeper — a booking page you host yourself](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/slot-keeper/): A booking page you host yourself: weekly hours, buffers, notice, your calendar's busy time respected, time zones, calendar invites, reminders and cancel or reschedule links. Open source, MIT, no per-seat fee. Try the slot finder in your browser.
- [status-keeper — your own status page, free](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/status-keeper/): A free, self-hosted status page with uptime monitoring, 90-day bars, incidents, maintenance windows and alerts. An open-source alternative to Statuspage, Instatus and Better Stack. MIT, zero dependencies.
- [Support Desk — a help desk you host yourself](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/support-desk/): A shared support inbox you host yourself: email and contact-form tickets, saved replies with suggestions, first-reply targets and a customer portal. Open source, MIT, no per-agent fee. Try the triage in your browser.
- [Survey Keeper — an NPS survey that says why the score is what it is](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/survey-keeper/): Run surveys and Net Promoter Score on a server you own: NPS with a 95% range, the words detractors use, results by source, CSV export and an alert on every detractor. Open source, MIT, no per-response fee. Try the NPS calculator in your browser.
- [Testimonial Keeper — collect testimonials and show a wall of love, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/testimonial-keeper/): Collect customer testimonials with a link, approve the ones you want, and show them on your site with one script tag. Consent stored with every entry. Open source, MIT, one-click self-deploy, no monthly fee.
- [Trial Converter — trial-to-paid conversion for Stripe, self-hosted](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/trial-converter/): Turn more Stripe free trials into paying customers: card-on-file trials get an honest price-and-date heads-up, card-less trials get escalating add-a-card emails and an optional one-time extension. Preview the plan, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT.
- [visit-keeper — web analytics you own, free](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/visit-keeper/): Free, self-hosted, cookie-free web analytics: visitors, sources, UTM campaigns and goals with revenue by source. An open-source alternative to Plausible, Fathom and Simple Analytics. MIT, zero dependencies.
- [Waitlist Keeper — a self-hosted referral waitlist](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/waitlist-keeper/): A free, open-source alternative to Viral Loops and Prefinery: a launch waitlist where confirmed referrals move people up the line, with fraud guards and batch invites. Clean a pasted email list and project your viral growth in your browser, then run the server in your own account.
- [webhook-relay — keep webhooks safe while your app is down](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/webhook-relay/): Never lose a Stripe, GitHub or Shopify webhook because your app was down. Self-hosted relay that verifies signatures, saves events before answering, retries with backoff and replays on demand. Free, MIT, zero dependencies.

## Marketplace seller tools

Price a listing, a fee change, or a program before you opt in — with your own cost of goods in the arithmetic.

Category page: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/c/marketplace/

- [1099-K Reconciliation Worksheet — free, no sign-up](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/1099k-reconciliation-worksheet/): Free browser worksheet that reconciles one or more Form 1099-K Box 1a totals (Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot, StockX) down to an estimated net profit by backing out refunds, marketplace-remitted sales tax, fees, cost of goods, and shipping. Nothing uploaded.
- [Amazon FBA vs FBM Profit Calculator](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/amazon-fba-calculator/): Free Amazon FBA vs FBM calculator: compare fulfillment paths after expected returns. Get net profit, max buy cost, the return rate that wipes the listing, when inbound placement still beats split freight, and whether aged inventory still beats a removal.
- [Amazon Inventory Loader Check — free, private, in your browser](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/amazon-inventory-loader-check/): Free Amazon Seller Central inventory file checker: finds comma or UTF-16 files, UPCs that lost a leading zero, bad UPC and EAN check digits, scientific-notation SKUs, bad prices and quantities, wrong add-delete codes and missing condition notes, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.
- [Amazon PPC Search Term Analyzer — free, private, CSV in your browser](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/amazon-ppc-search-term-analyzer/): Free Amazon PPC search term analyzer: drop in your Sponsored Products search term report CSV and see wasted ad spend graded by evidence, negative keyword candidates, terms to harvest into exact match with break-even bids, and spend above your target ACOS. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.
- [Amazon Seller Profit Analyzer — free, private, CSV in your browser](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/amazon-seller-profit-analyzer/): Free Amazon seller profit analyzer: drop in your Seller Central Transaction report CSV and get profit per SKU, a fee waterfall, ad spend, refund and reimbursement findings. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.
- [Amazon settlement report to Xero / QuickBooks journal — free, private](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/amazon-settlement-to-journal/): Free Amazon settlement report to journal converter: proves the rows add up to the deposit, splits sales, fees, refunds and tax by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [App Review Insights — free, private, CSV in your browser](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/app-review-insights/): Free app review analyzer: drop in your Google Play or App Store review CSV and see which release dropped your rating, which complaints cost the most stars, and which unhappy reviews you have not answered. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
- [What does an app subscriber really leave you after store fees?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/app-subscription-proceeds-calculator/): Free calculator for indie app developers: what a subscription charge really leaves after store fees, tax and refunds, what a subscriber is worth at your churn, how long payback takes, and what a web checkout would change. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [Auction Car Flip Calculator — free, private, in your browser](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/auction-car-flip-calculator/): Auction car flip calculator for dealers and flippers. Enter resale price, repairs, the auction's buyer fee tiers, transport, tax and holding costs to get the max bid, the break-even bid, and a stress table for repair overruns and a lower resale. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [Axe Throwing Bar Profit Calculator — monthly profit, payback and break-even fill](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/axe-throwing-bar-profit-calculator/): Free calculator for axe throwing bars and venues. Enter thrower capacity, sessions, fill, ticket price, private events, leagues, staff, rent and the build; it shows monthly profit, margin, payback, break-even fill and the lowest ticket for your target margin and payback. Private, in your browser.
- [Bail Bond Agency Exposure Calculator — free](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/bail-bond-agency-exposure-calculator/): Free tool for bail bond agents: enter your open bonds, collateral and surety terms to see net premium, the loss if bonds are forfeited, whether cash covers the largest ones, and a court-date call list. Runs in your browser.
- [Barbershop Chair Profit Calculator — free, private](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/barbershop-chair-profit-calculator/): Free barbershop calculator: enter haircut, beard and combo prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per cut and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even cuts per week and whether to rent the chair or employ a barber. Runs in your browser.
- [BigCommerce Product CSV Check — free, private, in your browser](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/bigcommerce-product-csv-check/): Free BigCommerce product CSV checker: finds SKU rows with no product or option set, duplicate SKUs, bad prices, wrong Y/N flags, wrong barcode check digits, broken image URLs, Excel-damaged SKUs and semicolon files, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.
- [Braiding Studio Profit Calculator — free, private](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/braiding-studio-profit-calculator/): Free braiding studio calculator: enter knotless, cornrow and twist prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per style and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even styles per week and whether to rent the chair or employ a braider. ## Logistics, freight & cloud cost

Normalise a quote, audit a bill, or size a transfer window before you sign for it.

Category page: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/c/logistics/

- [3PL Invoice Audit Checker](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/3pl-invoice-audit-checker/): Check a 3PL invoice against your contract rate card and your own records. ## Compliance checks & evidence records

Category page: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/c/evidence/

## CI checks & developer gates

Audit a GitHub Actions workflow for injection, over-broad permissions, unpinned actions and cache poisoning; tell a starved runner from a real failure; catch a coverage drop, classify flaky tests, see which AI crawlers your robots.txt allows, catch a dependency that just gained an install-time script or could be confused with an internal package, find a missing iOS privacy-manifest declaration before App Review does, or catch a page whose JSON-LD no longer matches its own visible text — free, local, no account.

Category page: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/c/ci/

- [Can a fork PR's artifact get executed by your privileged workflow?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-artifact-poisoning-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find a workflow_run job that downloads an artifact and later executes something from it, plus a download-artifact step with no name: pin. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Can a fork PR poison your GitHub Actions cache?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-cache-poisoning-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find actions/cache steps reachable from pull_request_target/workflow_run, and restore-keys fallbacks that can adopt a poisoned prefix match. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Which of your Actions jobs leave the GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-checkout-credentials-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every actions/checkout step without persist-credentials: false, with jobs that also upload artifacts (the artipacked pattern) listed first. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Is your GitHub Actions workflow open to a pwn request or script injection?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-injection-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find pull_request_target/workflow_run 'pwn request' checkouts and shell script-injection from untrusted ${{ github.event }} expressions. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [What will this GitHub Actions workflow cost you a month?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-minutes-estimator/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and see projected monthly billable minutes and dollar cost before the allowance runs out. Names the expensive patterns: the macOS 10x multiplier, per-job rounding on wide matrices, missing timeout-minutes, PR commits built twice, over-frequent cron. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
- [Does your GITHUB_TOKEN use least-privilege permissions?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-permissions-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every workflow or job with no explicit permissions block (running on the ambient default) or permissions: write-all. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Is your red GitHub Actions check even real?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-runner-starvation-check/): Paste the JSON from a GitHub Actions run and find out in one click whether a red check is a real failure or GitHub silently never assigned it a runner. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Which of your GitHub Actions steps run on a deprecated Node runtime?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-runtime-deprecation-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and list every actions/* step pinned to a major that runs on a deprecated Node runtime (Node 12 or 16) or that GitHub has shut down. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Will your GitHub Actions schedule cron actually run when you think it will?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-schedule-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every schedule cron that is invalid, faster than GitHub's 5-minute minimum, or pinned to the top of the hour where scheduled runs get delayed. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Does your GitHub Actions workflow leak a secret GitHub's own masking can't catch?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-secret-leak-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find the two documented ways a secret slips past GitHub's own log masking: transforming it (base64/hex/substring) before printing, and exporting it to $GITHUB_ENV/$GITHUB_OUTPUT without ::add-mask::. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Does secrets: inherit hand your secrets to the wrong workflow?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-secrets-inherit-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every secrets: inherit call that hands your whole secret set to an external reusable workflow, or to a job a fork can trigger. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Is your self-hosted GitHub Actions runner exposed to a fork?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-self-hosted-exposure-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every job that runs on a self-hosted label in a workflow triggered by pull_request, pull_request_target, workflow_run, or issue_comment — the exact pattern GitHub's own docs warn against on public repos. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Which of your GitHub Actions jobs can hang for 6 hours?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-timeout-check/): Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every job with no timeout-minutes (or one set to the 360-minute default) — the jobs that can hang for six hours of billed runner time. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Does your pinned workflow load something unpinned underneath it?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/actions-transitive-pin-check/): Paste a GitHub Actions workflow and check whether a reusable workflow or composite action it pins to a commit SHA itself loads a third-party action by a mutable tag underneath — a gap a top-level SHA pin does not close.
- [Does your AI coding agent's instruction file still match your repo?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/agent-instructions-drift-check/): Paste your AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or copilot-instructions.md and see every file path it references that no longer exists, every npm run script it names that isn't defined, and known interpreter-mismatch shell footguns (bare pytest/mypy instead of python3 -m). - [ShootFlow | Safe ingest and deliverables for photographers](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/photo-editing/): ShootFlow is an early-stage open-source toolkit for safely ingesting photo and video media and planning graded reels, carousels and photo sets.
- [Photos Import Tools | Resumable macOS photo import](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/photos-import-tools/): Resumable, manifest-backed command-line tools that import JPEG and RAW photos into Apple Photos and offload SD cards with hash verification.
- [Podcast Feed Validator](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/podcast-feed-check/): Free tool: paste your podcast's RSS feed XML and check it against the documented Apple Podcasts feed requirements and the RSS 2.0 spec -- missing title/description/language/category/explicit/artwork, an invalid pubDate format, a missing atom:link rel=self, and duplicate episode guids (the documented cause of an episode reappearing as new or disappearing from a podcast app). A zero-dependency CLI fetches your feed URL for real. Runs in your browser or as a CI check. Nothing uploaded.
- [Podcast Sponsorship Rate Calculator — free, no sign-up](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/podcast-sponsorship-rate-calculator/): Free podcast sponsorship rate calculator. Enter your average downloads per episode, niche, and read type to get a price range for a pre-roll, mid-roll, and post-roll ad spot — based on commonly cited podcast-ad-market CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.
- [How much should I charge for my pottery? Free cost-per-piece calculator](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/pottery-piece-pricing-calculator/): Free pottery pricing calculator. Clay, glaze, kiln firing cost, breakage, your hours and studio rent in; true cost per sellable piece, the retail and wholesale price for your target margin and your hourly return out. Nothing uploaded.
- [Prop Firm Challenge Calculator](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/prop-firm-challenge-calculator/): Simulate a funded-trader evaluation with your own win rate, reward:risk and risk per trade. Pass probability under a profit target, daily loss limit and static or trailing drawdown, expected fees to pass, funded payouts and the break-even win rate. Free, private, in your browser.
- [Proposal Maker — free client proposal generator, no signup](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/proposal-maker/): Free proposal generator for freelancers, consultants and small agencies: scope with included and excluded lists, phases with dates, fixed, good-better-best, hourly-with-cap or retainer pricing, deposit and milestones, change-order wording, acceptance block, print to PDF. No account, no watermark, works offline.
- [Quick Pick | Pairwise preference survey engine](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/quick-pick-survey/): An open-source pairwise-comparison survey engine: pick one of two options, repeat, and it infers a ranked preference ordering with confidence intervals, including trade-offs people cannot state directly.

Shows the break-even year and the rent that makes them equal. Nothing uploaded.

## More free tools

Everything else that runs entirely in your browser.

Category page: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/c/more/

- [Free Electronics Calculators](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/ai-engineering-academy/): A small set of free, private electronics calculators that run entirely in your browser: resistor color codes and Ohm's law, LED series resistors, voltage dividers with load correction, and 555 timer astable/monostable design. No signup, no ads, nothing uploaded.
- [Compare college financial aid offers by what you will really pay](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/aid-award-letter-comparator/): Free financial aid award letter comparator. Type in each college's cost, grants, loans and work-study and see the true four-year cost, loans repaid with interest, the year-2 price jump and the grant that would match the cheapest offer. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [JWT Security Check](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/jwt-security-check/): Paste a JWT and get its header and payload decoded, plus every common security misconfiguration flagged: alg:none, embedded jwk/jku/x5u/x5c key material, symmetric-vs-asymmetric algorithm confusion, a kid header shaped like path traversal or SQL injection, missing/excessive exp, and sensitive-looking fields in the unencrypted payload. Free JWT decoder and security checker, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.
- [What time is it there — and are they awake?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/world-clock-widget/): A free world clock that shows current local time, sunrise, sunset, daylight length and whether each city is awake — for as many cities as you like, side by side. Sunrise and sunset are computed in your browser from the US Naval Observatory almanac algorithm. No account, no upload, no API key.
